# Maktabah Muhammadiya

Maktabah Muhammadiya is an online Islamic bookshop offering curated Islamic books,
Arabic and Urdu titles, modest clothing, and selected essentials.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://maktabahmuhammadiyya.lovable.app/
- Shop: https://maktabahmuhammadiyya.lovable.app/shop
- About: https://maktabahmuhammadiyya.lovable.app/about
- Contact: https://maktabahmuhammadiyya.lovable.app/contact
- Sitemap: https://maktabahmuhammadiyya.lovable.app/sitemap.xml

## Catalog Focus

- Aqeedah
- Tafsir
- Hadith
- Fiqh
- Seerah
- Qur'an
- Purification
- Character development
- Family and marriage
- Women's issues
- Islamic history
- Arabic books
- Urdu books
- Modest clothing
